entries.summary: POAP KINGS: 12232 battles in 3143 sessions by 56 players who were members during the window (roster now 46) since Aug 25; joined: NOBITA, Brotherinpants, ㅤᴀɴᴅᴇʀㅤ:), VVSBUDGET, duki suzuki; left: Prince Aravind, Ram, pax, Ditaka, Th15_Guy +3; roles: pax elder→member, Th15_Guy elder→member, L-Drxgo⚡ member→elder; roster 50→46; week 1 finished in place 1 with 10,000 fame; week 2 finished in place 1 with 10,000 fame; training day; quiet past 10d: Ｓｈａｆｉｔｈ Ｎｉｈａｌ♥️ (10d), pokemon (9d), VVSBUDGET (8d), alex (8d); back: pax after 7d; most battles: Vijay 1342, Aaqib Javed 1170, sikander sidhu 964; new bests: sikander sidhu 14,000, Ak 11,509, nyje47 9,056; 4 arena promotions (x.x.hari.x.x → Royal Crypt, x.x.hari.x.x → Silent Sanctuary, Ak → Summit of Heroes); ranked: Aaqib Javed → Master 2, Aaqib Javed → Master 2, TDuck → Master 2; standout sessions: sikander sidhu 17W-5L +318 (7 in a row), NOBITA 10W-34L -34, sikander sidhu 22W-22L +7 (6 in a row); badges: bonus 22 (Miner Mastery, Dark Prince Mastery, Sparky Mastery), Andy 9 (Minions Mastery, Tesla Mastery, Baby Dragon Mastery), sikander sidhu 8 (Ice Wizard Mastery, 2v2, Royal Hogs Mastery); donations this week 418, led by sikander sidhu (62).

notes: Window spans S135 (2026-08) and S136 (2026-09); the season rolls on the first Monday at 10:00Z and applied.window.crosses says where, so read either side as its own season.
